39303.commentary: (MNa) paccaggaḷe aṭṭhāsī'ti patiaggaḷ'eva aṭṭhāsi. aggaḷaṃ vuccati kavāṭaṃ, mukhena uggantvā paṇṇasālato nikkhamitvā bahipaṇṇasālāya kavāṭaṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya. tassa so alagaddo paṭiparivattitvā hatthe vā bāhāya vā aññatarasmiṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅge ḍaṃseyya.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya, uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ natthukammaṃ. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya.
n'eva tāv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho'ti paccaññāsiṃ

paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule, piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghābalaṃ mamā'ti.

examples.text: atha kho upāli gahapati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bhante, gacchāma, bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā'ti.

39379.meaning1: dependency; conditionality; causal connection; causal relation
39379.construction:
pati > paty > pacc + √i > ay + *a + tā
paccaya + tā
39379.commentary: (MNa) idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppādo'ti imesaṃ paccayā idappaccayā, idappaccayā eva idappaccayatā, idappaccayatā ca sā paṭiccasamuppādo cā'ti idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppādo.

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto loko'ti. avijjā'ti… pubb'ante aññāṇaṃ apar'ante aññāṇaṃ pubb'ant'āpar'ante aññāṇaṃ, idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ

39380.construction:
pati > paty > pacc + √i > ay + *a + tta
paccaya + tta

39381.meaning1: fact of having been made into support (for)

39384.commentary: (PMa) paccayanirodh'aṭṭhenā'ti paccayassa niruddhabhāvenā'ti attho. nirodho c'ettha anāgatapaṭisandhipaccayānaṃ idha avijjā-taṇhā-kammānaṃ'y'eva nirodho.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ paccayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayasamudayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.

39385.meaning1: leading to the ending of the supporting condition

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ paccayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayasamudayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.
[oramattha (syā. kaṃ. pī.), oramatha, oramati (ka.), atha naṃ (sī.), oramiyā'ti pana tvāpaccay'anta-tatha-saṃvaṇṇan'ānurūpaṃ visodhitapadaṃ]

39387.meaning2: what is called using the requisites

39389.meaning1: invitation for requisites; offer of support
39389.commentary: (MNa) icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ catumāsaṃ bhesajjena pavāretun'ti (pāci. 303) ca aññatra punapavāraṇāya aññatra niccapavāraṇāyā'ti (pāci. 307) ca ayaṃ paccayapavāraṇā. pavārito nāma asanaṃ paññāyati, bhojanaṃ paññāyati, hatthapāse ṭhito abhiharati, paṭikkhepo paññāyati, eso pavārito nāmā'ti (pāci. 239) ayaṃ anatirittapavāraṇā. paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresī'ti (dī. ni. 1.297, 358) ayaṃ yāva'd'atthapavāraṇā. ayam'idha adhippetā.

examples.text: agilānena bhikkhunā catumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā aññatra punapavāraṇāya, aññatra niccapavāraṇāya. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

39390.meaning1: section containing the discussion about requisites

examples.text: yathā vā pana thālakañ'ca vaṭṭi ca telañ'ca padīpassa paccayabhūtaṃ na sabhāvahetu, na hi sakkā thālakañ'ca vaṭṭiñ'ca telañ'ca anaggikaṃ dīpetuṃ padīpassa paccayabhūtaṃ. padīpo viya sabhāvo hetu hoti.
tatiyajjhāne hi sukhassa paccayabhūtā pīti sabbaso niruddhā'ti.

39393.commentary: (PMa) paccayasamuday'aṭṭhenā'ti paccayassa uppannabhāvenā'ti attho. avijjā-taṇhā-kammāni c'ettha idha paṭisandhihetubhūtā atītapaccayā. imesu ca tīsu gahitesu saṅkhār'upādānāni gahitān'eva honti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ paccayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayasamudayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ paccayanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.

39398.grammar: idiom, masc + abs, abs of paccayaṃ karoti
39398.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.2) etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññan'ti na añño koci paccayo hoti uyyojetuṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubb'upagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti, ekakassa me kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hotī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.

39399.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, abl sg of paccaya
39399.meaning1: dependent on; due to; caused by
39399.construction:

paccaya + ā

examples.text: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā
purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti. evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati, idappaccayā avijjā'ti
